The company expects to invest approximately £68 million, anticipating double-digit, inflation-protected returns over 23.5 years of availability-based revenues linked to the UK Consumer Price Index. This twelfth OFTO investment will contribute to the UK's net-zero transition, powering an additional 1.3 million homes, bringing the total OFTO portfolio capacity to 5.0 million homes. The investment will be funded through realization proceeds, surplus cash, and corporate debt, with the company having already realized or committed to over £440 million in portfolio sales since July 2023, reinvesting approximately £480 million into new investments with average returns exceeding 11%. Disclaimer* International Public Partnerships 15 October 2026 OFGEM ANNOUNCEMENT ON MORAY WEST OFTO INVESTMENT 15 October 2026 International Public Partnerships Limited, the listed infrastructure investment company ('the Company', 'INPP'), is pleased to announce that yesterday Ofgem published a notice setting out the proposed license and associated documentation for the Moray West Offshore Transmission project ('OFTO') [1] . This represents a key regulatory step towards financial close, anticipated in December 2026. The Moray West OFTO relates to the offshore electricity transmission assets connecting to the Moray West wind farm located in the Moray Firth off the coast of Scotland. INPP expects to invest c.£68 million into the project upon financial close, and this investment is expected to: § Generate double-digit, inflation-protected returns; § Reach financial close in December 2026; § Receive 23.5 years of availability-based revenues linked to UK Consumer Price Index; § Represent the Company's twelfth OFTO investment; § Further contribute to the UK's transition to net zero; and § Provide the renewable capacity to power the equivalent of c.1.3 million homes, increasing the total equivalent across the Company's OFTO portfolio to c.5.0 million homes. This investment is expected to be funded using a combination of realisation proceeds, surplus cash and as previously highlighted, use of short-term corporate debt facilities to align with the timings of cash being received from the realisation activities. As at 14 October 2026, the Company's £350 million corporate debt facility was c.£36 million drawn with c.£180 million committed by letters of credit, the majority of which is to support the Company's commitment to Sizewell C [2] . The Company has realised or committed to realise over £440 million across the portfolio since July 2023. All realisations have been made in line with, or above the relevant published NAV. During the same time period, the Company has announced its commitment to reinvest c.£480 million into investments with an average return in excess of 11%, including Moray West OFTO. This capital recycling has resulted in an uplift of more than 2% in returns for every pound of capital recycled. ENDS.
